# a spec-fidelity report that says it cannot tell

    FIDELITY: cannot determine from spec + diff alone

An honest gap is a legitimate verdict, not a failure to produce one. A gate that treats "I
cannot tell from these two files" as a defect teaches the agent to guess, which is the
exact failure the isolation exists to prevent.
